messages:
Ravi (PM): Quick sync please — Tenant QoS v1 needs a go/no-go by Wed so we can lock infra. Questions: can we support per-tenant isolation on shared GPUs w/out dedicated pools? And what's realistic for launch acceptance?

Tess (Eng): Short answer: yes, with scheduling + throttles. Need CPU/GPU quotas and per-tenant model pinning in the scheduler. Risk: noisy neighbors if preemption not tuned. Estimate: 2w to wire quotas + tests.

Ivy (Runtime): From runtime side: we can enforce model pins and soft eviction of KV cache. We can't guarantee strict latency SLAs on a saturated shared pool. Suggest a hybrid: soft-shared for small tenants + reserved slots for enterprise tiers. Also propose an eviction grace period and graceful degradation path.

Chris (Infra): Infra idea: node taints + nodePools by priority, plus node-level cgroups for GPU isolation where supported. Capacity math: ~1 extra GPU per 4-6 medium tenants. Current spare pool = 2 GPUs. If PM wants 10 tenants in pilot, we'll need +2 GPUs immediately. Need headcount/time to reprovision clusters and update manifests.

Nina (Security): Security requirements: attestation for tenant workloads on shared hosts, ephemeral key scoping (KMS nonce per tenant), and enhanced audit logging. We also need a short doc for customer SOC review. Without attestation we can't sign off on regulated customers.

Ravi (PM): Proposed minimal acceptance criteria for v1:
```
- per-tenant routing + model pinning enabled
- CPU/GPU quota enforcement for tenants
- fallback path: baseline fp16 model if reserved slot unavailable
- KMS-per-tenant + audit logs (basic)
- rollout via canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on p95 breaches
```
Any missing must-haves?

Tess (Eng): Add: a feature flag to opt-out noisy tenants and a CI test that simulates spike eviction. Also: `ci/model-compile` pipeline needs faster caching or builds will block releases.

Ivy (Runtime): We'll implement cache snapshotting and a light prewarm job for heavy tenants. Will add warmers to canary plan. Cold-start penalty for compiled quantized models ~120-200ms depending on model size.

Chris (Infra): I'll prepare a cluster reprovision plan and a PR for nodePools + taints. Target to have GPUs available by Tue EOD if we pause some test fleets.

capacity-bot: Heads-up: capacity reassign window closes in 36h.

Ravi (PM): Thanks — Ravi scheduling a short standup Tue 9:30 to resolve GPUs and launch checklist. If anyone can't make it, drop blockers here.
